faq.q: Do I really need a maintenance plan?
faq.a: If your site is on WordPress or WooCommerce, effectively yes - unpatched plugins are the main attack route. On a hosted platform like Shopify or Framer the platform handles more, so the need is smaller.
You can, if you will genuinely do it monthly and know how to recover from a failed update. The reason most owners pay for it is that it gets skipped until something breaks.

faq.q: What happens if I skip it?
faq.a: Usually nothing, for a while. Then a plugin vulnerability gets exploited, or an update breaks the checkout, and the recovery costs more than a year of maintenance would have.
